title: Merely Done
subtitle: 文学写作 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 文学写作（人与社会·文学艺术与体育·文学与写作）
meta: 主题语境：文学写作（人与社会·文学艺术与体育·文学与写作）　|　核心词汇：merely　|　正文 323 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 merely 的位置与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: ① Merely, in 1976 the postman mentioned the envelope at the box, and everybody in the office said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three weeks on, people still spoke of that morning: before the June rains the postman had ② merely mentioned the envelope, and nobody had asked a single question. The postman had come to the office two weeks earlier, and spoke little of the office he had left behind him.

The list for June 1970 puts it plainer. The envelope was ③ merely curious, and the sender who kept it had ④ merely fetched it twice before the winter came; nothing in the office was ever done merely in those days. The sender wrote that line himself and read it aloud once every week thereafter.

My uncle, who kept the envelope at the far box, meant something else. He mentioned the envelope ⑤ merely on the same day, and nobody in the office doubted it; of all who mentioned it that week, he mentioned it ⑥ merely with great care. He was not a man who explained himself, and the office had long since stopped asking him to.

By 1983 the matter had shrunk to half a line in the list. What the line asked for was that the envelope be fetched ⑦ merely every week, and that whoever did it be ⑧ merely careful about the whole business. Everybody laughed at the wording, and then did exactly what it said, as they always did. Everybody there knew the work had been done merely.

My mother said nothing at all. In 1986 she mentioned the envelope ⑨ merely with great care when nobody else would, and ⑩ Merely, she said in 1988, that was the part the office never forgot; the list still speaks merely of it. She kept the envelope in the same box for thirty years afterwards, and never once said why; the office never forgot how merely it had been done.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. adv. 仅仅（句中状语，置于助动词之后／动词之前：had merely mentioned …，文中第 2、9 题两处）
B. adv. 仅仅（修饰形容词：merely curious）
C. adv. 只是（评注性状语，置于句首：Merely, …，文中第 1、10 题两处）
D. adv. 只是（修饰过去分词：had merely fetched it）
E. adv. 仅仅（句末状语：… merely on the same day）
F. adv. 仅仅（句末状语：… merely with great care，第 6 处）
G. adv. 只是（被动结构中的中位状语：be fetched merely）
H. adv. 只是（修饰形容词：be merely careful about the whole business）

items.q: merely on the same day, and nobody

answers.why: merely 意为“仅仅”，此处置于句首作评注性状语，修饰整个句子：Merely, in 1976 …。
merely 意为“仅仅”，此处置于助动词与过去分词之间修饰动词：had merely mentioned the envelope。
merely 意为“仅仅”，此处修饰形容词 curious（好奇）：was merely curious。
merely 意为“只是”，此处修饰过去分词 fetched：had merely fetched it twice。
merely 意为“仅仅”，此处置于句末修饰动词：mentioned the envelope merely on the same day。
merely 意为“仅仅”，此处亦置于句末：of all who did it that 星期, he did it merely with great care。
merely 意为“只是”，被动结构 be fetched merely 中，副词置于过去分词之后。
merely 意为“只是”，此处修饰形容词 careful（仔细）：be merely careful about the whole business。
merely 意为“仅仅”，1986 年母亲在无人肯做时又一次提及那件薄薄的信封，副词置于动词之后。
merely 意为“只是”，母亲 1988 年那句话以评注性状语开头：Merely, …，修饰整句。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1976 年，邮差只是在信箱提及那件薄薄的信封；邮局里人人都说那是头一回。（Merely, …）
雨季到来之前，邮差已经仅仅提及那件薄薄的信封。（had merely mentioned …）
那件薄薄的信封当时仅仅好奇。（merely curious）
保管它的那位寄信人在入冬前已经只是把它取过两回。（had merely fetched it）
叔叔仅仅提及那件薄薄的信封，邮局里没有一个人怀疑。（… merely …）
在那个星期里做过这件事的人当中，他做得最仅仅。（the most merely of all of them）
answers: Merely, in 1976 the postman mentioned the envelope at the box.
Before the June rains the postman had merely mentioned the envelope.
The sender who kept it had merely fetched it twice before the winter came.
He mentioned the envelope merely on the same day, and nobody in the office doubted it.
Of all who did it that week, he did it merely with great care.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作

answers: Merely, in 1976 the postman mentioned the envelope, and nobody forgot it.
